design.stage: EAB round 12: weak-encoder ablation of Finding 1

encoder.name: torchvision ResNet-18, IMAGENET1K_V1 weights (downloaded with user approval 2026-10-22)
encoder.layer: global average pool, 512-d, eval mode, frozen
encoder.preprocessing: as DINOv2: bicubic resize to 224, ImageNet mean/std
encoder.reduction: PCA to 128 fitted on the 2000 public proxy images only (randomized, random_state 1729), then row L2 normalization

design.identities: same private/development/proxy/validation/test image ids as release-frontier inputs/cifar10.npz; labels asserted equal

setting.release: T=1, K=C=10 public regions, estimator M
setting.head_fixed_release: also run (clip 1), as in the reference confirmation

labels.feature_directed: geometry_labels policy (q nearest development points per public K=C region, recomputed in the ResNet-18 geometry), q in {1,3,5}

design.evaluation: release-frontier anchored_fusion.main(confirm=True) with module roots pointed at this stage; joint naming and fourteen public learners with exact LOO
design.noise_note: release noise keys are the reference formula (seed*1000003+steps*101+20261019), so the two encoders share noise tapes; paired by design

primary.E1: random acquisition, m=10: mean over 100 draws x 10 cohorts of (joint naming accuracy - strongest mean public learner accuracy) has crossed-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 (2000 replicates, seed 20261022)
primary.E2: feature-directed acquisition, m=10, public only: accuracy of the selected public portfolio >= mean random-acquisition joint naming accuracy at m=10 (acquisition substitutes for private reports)

predictions: partition ceilings (one-to-one, many-to-one, K=C) are lower than with DINOv2
the random-acquisition joint gain at m=10 is smaller than with DINOv2 (+13.0)
with feature-directed m=10 labels, the mean joint naming accuracy exceeds the directed public portfolio by at most 1 point
descriptive: all six label budgets for random acquisition
